physical_interface: CAN classic, current C-board configuration 1 Mbps, node ID 1
fault_semantics: MCU-local safety gates are represented by source and host tests; this public snapshot contains no raw hardware acceptance evidence.
stop_semantics: MCU sends a zero-current command at deadline or fault; stop receipt is not mechanical standstill evidence.
hardware_conditions: C-board, drive supply, common reference, CAN wiring, termination, current limit and quick power cut require per-run verification.
Only the existing fixed-ID C620 adapter is represented; no other motor or drive is implied.
